cells.gaps: The 32,600 displaced people of the West Region are registered with a number, but no source says identity documents were issued to them. No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.
cells.note: Stage 2: UNHCR registered over 32,600 displaced people in the West Region, and biometric ID cards for refugees and displaced people are in progress. No source says documents were issued with a number, so not 3.
